validation_ack.reason: Panin's reported payout (39.21%, AR2025 PDF p. 285) is the dividend over the PARENT-ONLY net profit approved by the AGMS (Rp2,577.514bn, Ringkasan RUPST 26 Jun 2025), not the consolidated attributable profit (Rp2,738.143bn) stored in net_profit_attr: 2,738.1 x 39.21% = 1,073.6 vs the actual Rp1,010.8bn dividend. 1,010.762 / 2,577.514 = 39.21%. Real definitional gap, not a data error.

The 38% payout reported for FY2025 (IDX Channel, 21 Jun 2026) is relative to the PARENT-ONLY FY2025 net profit Rp2,678.052bn (Dec-2025 audited published statement, individual column; 1,011.0 / 2,678.1 = 37.8%), not the consolidated attributable Rp2,750.044bn stored in net_profit_attr (2,750.0 x 38% = 1,045.0 vs Rp1,011.0bn). Same convention as FY2024 (AR2025 p. 285).

research_notes: IDENTITY: PNBN = PT Bank Pan Indonesia Tbk (abbreviated PT Bank Panin Tbk; brand PaninBank). NOT Maybank Indonesia (BNII), which the request mislabelled. Controlling shareholders: PT Panin Financial Tbk 46.04% and Votraint No. 1103 Pty Ltd 38.82% (Dec 2025). Conventional bank; consolidates PT Clipan Finance Indonesia Tbk (CFIN, 51.49% throughout) and PT Bank Panin Dubai Syariah Tbk (PNBS; 53.70% at end-2019, 69.93% end-2020, 67.30% from end-2021 after PNBS share issues), both listed.

SOURCE ACCESS: www.panin.co.id (Akamai 'Access Denied') and www.idx.co.id block this server; no challenge was bypassed. Every Panin document was downloaded from Internet Archive snapshots of the exact panin.co.id URLs stored in source_url (route: https://web.archive.org/web/<timestamp>id_/<source_url>; timestamps in sources.md). The ONLY archived copies of AR2024 and AR2025 are truncated at 5 MiB; their text was recovered by rebuilding the page tree from the complete objects in the truncated file (scripts/salvage_pdf.py). The rebuilt AR2025 has all 954 page objects in the original order (page numbers cited = original PDF pages, cross-checked against printed folios), with images and part of the late sections missing; every value used from them is in the recovered text and was cross-checked against complete documents (published statements / interim FS). The FY2024 and FY2025 audited FS files are scanned images (and also truncated), so the 31 Dec 2024 / 31 Dec 2025 audited balances are taken from the comparative columns of the Q1-2025 / Q1-2026 interim FS, and FY2024/FY2025 profit and EPS from the audited OJK-format published statements.

CONSOLIDATION SCOPE: all money figures are consolidated (Bank + Clipan Finance + Panin Dubai Syariah). loans_gross = FS 'Kredit' gross, which includes PDSB sharia financing but excludes Clipan Finance's consumer-financing, lease and factoring receivables (consumer financing alone Rp5.7-8.6tn net in FY2020-FY2025; separate captions).
